text: 58-year-old female. The patient has been treated for community-acquired pneumonia with levofloxacin on the medical floor. She reports developing watery diarrhea with at least 9 episodes within the last two days, accompanied by lower abdominal discomfort and cramping.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given your recent treatment with levofloxacin for pneumonia, this presentation is highly suspicious for *Clostridioides difficile* infection. Have you experienced any fever or noticed blood in your stool? Also, please note any other symptoms like nausea or vomiting.
